notes: Thirty-six environmental review documents, one per project, for the named single-site projects of 1979-2005 that the collection titles by project name rather than by street address - the group the earlier batches' leading-digit filter never reached, continuing the named-sites-1974-1982 batch. Institutional campuses, area and policy plans, transportation, airport and out-of-city documents were left to their own groups, and projects an earlier batch had already read under another title were dropped. The richest are the Emporium site expansion (thirteen buildings on and around Jessie Street, each with a date, an architect or builder, and an occupancy history), the Geneva Office Building demolition project (a single City landmark documented from its 1900 groundbreaking to its closure after Loma Prieta), the North Beach Hope VI survey (a 105-property National Register evaluation of Francisco, Mason, Taylor, Water and Vandewater Streets), First and Howard, Brannan Square and the Neiman Marcus expansion. Ten of the thirty-six yielded nothing.
